description.fallback: In the morning, Boruto complains about having ramen for breakfast. Naruto says it's a different flavour from the ones they had the previous night. Boruto decides to switch it up and uses some ingredients from Naruto's fridge to make the ramen spicier, while Sasuke watches them from afar.
